concerns.text: FR-003.2 requires a feature‑selection step (e.g., L1 regularisation or RFE). The original idea never calls for feature selection; it only asks for compositional descriptors and a regression model. Adding mandatory feature selection is not required to answer the research question and therefore over‑reaches the scoped idea.

SC‑002 imposes a MAE ≤ 50 MPa threshold. The idea’s success criterion is an R² ≥ 0.5; no MAE bound was specified. Introducing a hard MAE limit adds a new evaluation requirement that was not part of the original scope.

SC‑003 demands that the standard deviation of feature‑importance ranks across bootstrap resamples be < 2.0. This stability metric was not mentioned in the idea and constitutes an additional success criterion beyond the intended research question.

SC‑004 requires measuring the full pipeline runtime against GitHub Actions free‑tier limits. Runtime budgeting was not part of the original idea; it is an engineering constraint that extends the scope beyond the scientific objective.
